_format: Copy to <TRADINGAGENTS_WEBUI_HOME>/cost-prices.json (default ~/.tradingagents/webui/cost-prices.json); UTF-8, a BOM is fine. models: { "<model id exactly as the run saved it, e.g. the quick/deep model name>": { "input_per_million": "<price per 1M input tokens>", "output_per_million": "<price per 1M output tokens>", "cache_read_per_million": "<optional: price per 1M input tokens that hit the provider cache>", "currency": "<3-letter code, e.g. USD or CNY>" } }. Prices are per million tokens: JSON numbers or plain decimal strings like "0.50" (no 1_000, 1e3, signs or spaces), from 0 to 10000; anything else makes that model 价格未知. currency defaults to USD when left out; an invalid code makes that model 价格未知. With cache_read_per_million, cache hits are priced at it and the rest of the input at input_per_million; without it, cache hits are priced at input_per_million and the role is marked 缓存命中按输入单价计. A run that mixes currencies shows 币种不一致，不计入合计 instead of a total. A model that is not listed shows 价格未知. Keys other than models are ignored. This template ships empty on purpose: no provider price is guessed.
